- The PRA requires that a report on the effectiveness of the model‑risk‑management (MRM) framework for financial reporting be provided to the audit committee on a regular basis and **at least annually**【1†para 3.8】.  
- The report must be supplied **in a timely manner** so the external auditor can use it when assessing and responding to the risk of material misstatement in the statutory audit【1†para 3.8】.
